title: ReadyCraft
tagline: Play Ready or Not's single player as a Minecraft player: build, break and fight through every mission.
description: Clear Ready or Not's missions with Minecraft's movement, hotbar and weapons. The officer's gear is put away: walk the levels by Minecraft's rules, build cover from blocks, break through, and take suspects down with Minecraft weapons and TNT. The game's bullets come off Minecraft's hearts. F still opens doors, cuffs suspects and collects evidence, and holding Left Alt gives you the officer for a moment. Single player only. Both games run at the same time: Minecraft runs hidden and Ready or Not draws everything.

version.note: Steam build 24942528 (Unreal Engine 5.3.2), DirectX 12. After a game update it needs a new build from its creator.
A Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. The app sets up Minecraft 26.3 itself.

waitFor.message: Getting Minecraft ready. The first start downloads Minecraft and takes a few minutes.

requirements.notes: About 3 GB of extra RAM for Minecraft. NVIDIA Frame Generation is off while it runs (DLSS upscaling still works).

credits.name: chasmlol
credits.role: Creator of SkyCraft, whose Minecraft side this mashup runs on

knownIssues: Early build: only a handful of short runs on one PC so far.
Single player only: go into Singleplayer, never public multiplayer.
Doors and other moving things aren't solid to Minecraft's player: you can walk through a closed door.
Minecraft's blocks are drawn over everything, and the game's people walk through them.
People lose health and go down but don't flinch, and your own team can't be hurt.
A game update stops it until its creator makes a new build.
Only one Minecraft X Games mashup can run at a time: they all drive the same kind of hidden Minecraft.
